messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We thank you for your commitment to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, which enables us to revise our pricing. We have selected your second package, incorporating the AS-14404 index and a 24-month contract term, to ensure mutual planning security. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 36 months. We cannot offer a fixed price over this extended period, so we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause to ensure mutual stability.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.34 per unit. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our products and for working with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. 

We are pleased to present our Angebot for a price of €5.25 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest, and that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. A Preisgleitklausel changes who carries the material risk, which is also priced in. 

Please be aware that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. We truly value our business relationship and look forward to serving your needs from our extensive range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
